versions.title: First Release
versions.summary: Make a character who is really yours, then dig, build and explore twenty biomes.
versions.intro: Untitled Game comes to the Firefly Launcher. Make a character, step into a world grown from its own seed, and dig, build and wander at your own pace.

sections.title: New
items: Avatar creator|Shape the face, body, hair, clothes and even tattoos, so your character looks just how you want.
Twenty biomes|Every world has meadows, deserts, snow, glowing caves and more, all grown from its own seed.
Dig and build|Break blocks with your bare hands and place them anywhere. Every material sounds and breaks its own way.
Controllers|Play with a controller, with rumble, or with mouse and keyboard.
Safe saves|Nine save files, kept outside the game with automatic backups.
